metadata.title: EyeVoice Indian Sign Language (ISL) Standard Lexicon
metadata.authority: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)
references: Samar Sinha (2018), Indian Sign Language: A Linguistic Analysis of Its Grammar
World Federation of the Deaf (WFD) Standards

parameters.handshape: Flat open palms (B-hand) pressed gently together or raised gracefully
parameters.orientation: Palms facing each other or outward toward partner
parameters.location: Center of chest or mid-level face
parameters.movement: Slight upward orientation with gentle forward bow of head
parameters.non_manual_markers: Warm smile, relaxed open facial expression, gentle nod

parameters.handshape: Closed fist (S-hand) or upright thumb (thumbs-up)
parameters.location: Neutral space in front of upper chest
parameters.movement: Dipping down at wrist repeatedly like a nodding head
parameters.non_manual_markers: Affirmative head nod, direct affirmative eye gaze

signs.meaning_en: No, I do not want that.

parameters.handshape: Extended index and middle fingers closing crisply against thumb or open palm pushed forward
parameters.movement: Sharp side-to-side oscillation or pushing outward
parameters.non_manual_markers: Headshake side to side, furrowed brows

parameters.handshape: Flat open hand (B-hand), fingers together
parameters.orientation: Fingertips touching chin or lower lip, palm facing inward then outward
parameters.movement: Smooth arc forward and slightly downward

parameters.handshape: Flat open hand (B-hand)
parameters.orientation: Palm contacting center of chest / sternum
parameters.non_manual_markers: Humble facial expression, soft eye contact

parameters.handshape: Dominant hand closed in fist (thumbs-up S-hand) resting upon flat non-dominant palm
parameters.orientation: Flat palm facing up, fist resting on top
parameters.location: Neutral space in front of torso
parameters.movement: Both hands moving together upward toward partner
parameters.non_manual_markers: Alert facial expression, raised brows or earnest appeal

parameters.handshape: W-handshape (Index, middle, and ring extended) or cupped hand
parameters.orientation: Fingertips pointing upward, palm facing inward/side
parameters.movement: Tapping gently against or tipping near lips

signs.meaning_en: I am hungry, I want food.

parameters.handshape: Flattened O-hand (all fingertips touching thumb)
parameters.non_manual_markers: Slight lip opening or chewing gesture

parameters.handshape: Dominant flat hand cutting down onto non-dominant flat horizontal palm
Dominant index and middle finger (D or M-hand) tapping the wrist pulse of non-dominant hand
parameters.movement: Two distinct taps on wrist pulse

signs.meaning_en: I am in pain, it hurts here.

parameters.handshape: Both index fingers extended pointing toward each other
parameters.orientation: Fingertips facing each other with small gap
parameters.location: In front of chest or location of hurt
parameters.movement: Sharp twisting oscillation towards each other
parameters.non_manual_markers: Grimace, squinted eyes, furrowed brow indicating discomfort

parameters.handshape: Curved open hands at chest rotating outward into open palms facing partner
parameters.orientation: Palms rotate from chest to upward/outward
parameters.movement: Bilateral outward rotation with slight forward reach
parameters.non_manual_markers: Raised eyebrows (question marker), head tilted forward

signs.meaning_en: I love you / I care about you.

parameters.handshape: Thumb, index, and pinky finger fully extended; middle and ring folded down
parameters.location: Chest level or raised toward partner
parameters.movement: Steady hold with gentle forward pulse

parameters.handshape: Index finger extended, other fingers folded
parameters.orientation: Index tip pointing directly to own chest/sternum
parameters.movement: Single contact or point toward center of chest

parameters.handshape: Index finger extended, other fingers folded
parameters.orientation: Index pointing directly at conversational partner
parameters.location: Neutral space in front of torso

signs.meaning_en: I want to rest and sleep.

parameters.handshape: Flat open hand or folded hands placed alongside tilted cheek
parameters.orientation: Palm touching cheek, head resting on hand
parameters.movement: Gentle head tilt resting on hand
parameters.non_manual_markers: Closed or softly relaxed eyes, relaxed facial tone

signs.meaning_en: Emergency! I need urgent help immediately.

parameters.handshape: Both hands open palms crossing sharply in front of chest
Dominant thumb and index forming small pill shape tapped at mouth or palm

signs.meaning_en: Please take me to the hospital.

parameters.handshape: Index finger tracing a cross '+' on upper shoulder or forehead

signs.meaning_en: I need to use the bathroom.

parameters.handshape: 'T' hand (thumb between index and middle) shaking side to side
Bent hands placed on chest dropping down slowly

signs.meaning_en: I am hungry, I want food.

parameters.handshape: 'C' handshape moving down the center of chest from throat to stomach

signs.meaning_en: What is happening? / What do you mean?

parameters.handshape: Both open palms facing up, moving side-to-side

signs.meaning_en: Where is it? / Where are we going?

parameters.handshape: Index finger extended upright, wagging side to side

signs.meaning_en: That is good. I like it.

parameters.handshape: Open hand touching chin and moving outward and down into non-dominant palm or thumbs-up
Both 'F' hands tracing an outward circle touching index/thumb at finish
